description: Stage two rendering: the certificate names the Application for an Order Expunging All Official Records and the Timeline as the documents served, and the movant role is Applicant. The prosecuting attorney's name and street address, the manner of service, the service date and the signature are all blank — the participant completes them from the current published address, because the certificate attests to what the participant actually did.

chargeData.chargeDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION OF THE CHARGE — NOT SUPPLIED BY LEGALEASE]
chargeData.disposition: proceedings deferred under W. Va. Code § 17C-5-2b without entry of a judgment of guilt; probation imposed; Motor Vehicle Alcohol Test and Lock Program completed; charges dismissed and defendant discharged under W. Va. Code § 17C-5-2b(c)
chargeData.arrestDate: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN ARREST DATE — NOT SUPPLIED BY LEGALEASE]
chargeData.arrestingAgency: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN ANSWER: THE AGENCY THAT ARRESTED THEM — NOT SUPPLIED BY LEGALEASE]

screeningAnswers.stageNeeded: the charges were already dismissed some time ago

screeningAnswers.probationTerm: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN ANSWER, TAKEN FROM THE ORDER DEFERRING PROCEEDINGS]
screeningAnswers.programCompletionDate: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DATE, CHECKED AGAINST THE DIVISION OF MOTOR VEHICLES CERTIFICATION]

screeningAnswers.dismissalDate: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DATE, CHECKED AGAINST THE ORDER OF DISMISSAL AND DISCHARGE]
screeningAnswers.commercialLicence: no — no commercial driver's licence and no commercial vehicle at the time

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. Whether the programme was satisfactorily completed, whether the conditions of probation were complied with, and whether any subsection (f) bar applies are the participant's own statements of fact, each checked by the participant against a document they obtain. Whether the prosecuting attorney objects, and how the court finds on any alleged probation violation, are never predicted.
eligibilityData.supportingDocumentNote: Every document named here is participant-obtained. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect any of them, and no drafted document characterises what any of them says.
servedDocuments: APPLICATION FOR AN ORDER EXPUNGING ALL OFFICIAL RECORDS OF THE ARREST, TRIAL AND CONVICTION PURSUANT TO W. VA. CODE § 17C-5-2b(g)
TIMELINE IN SUPPORT OF APPLICATION FOR AN ORDER EXPUNGING RECORDS PURSUANT TO W. VA. CODE § 17C-5-2b(g)(1)
eligibilityData.serviceCompletedNote: Never asserted. Service is the participant's own act and the certificate is signed and dated by the participant after they do it.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label is set by presentation.movantRole in the config, not by the fixture key name; the word petitioner is prohibited in rendered output.
identityFieldNote: caseData.docketNumber holds the participant's own case number and caseData.countyName their own county; both are required screening answers and are deliberately left blank in the fixtures under the artifact convention. The rendered document cannot go out without them; they are supplied by the participant, never by LegalEase. caseData.court is left blank because no source read for this track states the court level — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal.
